title: Arbayeen Karne Aayi Hai Zainab
body:
Arbayeen karne aayi hai Zainab.
Saat kunbe ko laayi hai Zainab.
1. Deen o islam ki baqa ke liye.
Bhai qushnudiye quda ke liye.
Dar badar phir ke aayi hai Zainab.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Dus moharram ka waqeaa bhaiyya.
Dil mera tukde hogaya bhaiyya.
Ranjo gham ki satayii hai Zainab.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Saat lekar loota huwa kunba.
Koofa o Shaam may rasan basta.
Berida phir ke aayi hai Zainab.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Saqt beemar Abid e muztar.
Chal basi qaid e Shaam may duqtar.
Yeh bhi sadma uthayi hai Zainab.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Roo rahe hain Kaleem ahle haram.
Ashk aankhao se bahtey hain paihum.
An watan jaane aayi hai Zainab.
Azz: Qaiser Kaleem.
